people.name: Sanjay D’Souza
people.role: Group Head – Business Banking, Emerging & Micro Enterprises Group and a Senior Management Personnel
people.evidence_quote: We wish to inform you that Mr. Sanjay D’Souza has superannuated from the services of the Bank with effect from the close of business hours on October 31, 2026 and has accordingly ceased to be the Group Head – Business Banking, Emerging & Micro Enterprises Group and a Senior Management Personnel of the Bank.
people.tenure_quote: During his association with the Bank for nearly 27 years, Mr. Sanjay D’Souza was one of the key architects of the Bank’s SME business, contributing significantly across both Credit and Business.
